fix_plan.description: Add idempotency check to prevent duplicate discount application by tracking discount IDs already applied.

files_to_modify.rationale: Prevents repeated application of the same discount by checking if the discount ID has already been processed, ensuring idempotency in the payment pipeline.

fix_plan.description: Prevent duplicate discount application by tracking applied discounts using a unique identifier within the payment service.

files_to_modify.rationale: The original function had no mechanism to detect repeated calls with the same discount. By introducing a set of applied discount IDs, we ensure each discount is applied only once per transaction flow.

fix_plan.description: Prevent duplicate discount application by tracking applied discounts with a unique key.

files_to_modify.rationale: Adds a guard against repeated application of the same discount by using a set to track already applied discount types and values, preventing the double discount issue at the function level.
